title: SettingAttachmentInterface
description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/setting/models.py::SettingAttachmentInterface exactly. The generic, category-neutral handoff between a Setting and whatever structure incorporates it. A RingHead consumes this today; a future PendantBody or EarringBody consumes the same contract. Every value is supplied BY the category integration — the Setting never computes them from category fields (SETTING-GOV-001/014). See docs/bible/21-setting/setting-attachment-interface.md.

attachmentPlaneZMm.description: Z of the plane the setting attaches down onto. For a ring this is the top of the band, but the Setting does not know that.

embedMm.description: How far setting geometry sinks past the attachment plane so a boolean union yields real 3D overlap rather than a tangent touch. A kernel/boolean-robustness value, never a jewelry threshold.

supportHeightMm.description: Vertical distance from the attachment plane up to the stone's girdle plane.
